natural_language: An author writes an expression that adds a quantity of work to a quantity of force. Work has the dimension of mass times length squared over time squared; force has mass times length over time squared. Decide whether the sum is meaningful and say what a language should do.

expected_semantics.reason: addition requires dimensional equality; work and force differ by a length

distractors: Adding the numbers anyway because both are reals once the units are stripped. This is precisely the error dimensional analysis exists to catch.
Assuming the mismatch will be caught downstream by a unit conversion. There is no conversion that makes a force commensurable with a work.
